author: KEXP
description:
Under the musical project Austra and on her fifth studio album ‘Chin Up Buttercup’, Toronto-based artist Katie Stelmanis shares a vivid expression of grief and healing through ‘90s dance and indie pop. With host Cheryl Waters, she shares a performance of “Fallen Cloud” and more Live on KEXP.

Watch the full listener-powered in-studio session on our channel and help power more of the sessions you love when you make a donation of any amount to our Spring Drive.
title: Austra - "Fallen Cloud" Live on KEXP
